Package com.kristensoft.kdc

Class TcpClientSocketOptions

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.kristensoft.kdc.TcpClientSocketOptions
  • public final class TcpClientSocketOptions
extends Object
    Defines socket options used to configure a TCP client socket.

    Socket options are applied when the TCP client creates its socket. Except where KDC provides an explicit default, an option value of null leaves the corresponding socket setting unchanged.

    By default, TCP keep-alive is enabled and SO_LINGER is enabled with a linger time of zero seconds. All other socket options are left unchanged unless explicitly configured.

    Instances are created using the TcpClientSocketOptions.Builder.

    Author:
    Charles B. Kozoyed
    See Also:
    TcpClientSocketOptions.Builder, SocketConfigurator
